$what: Every catalogue-safety finding that is TRUE OF PRODUCTION TODAY, so a new one is visible against a known floor.
$why: S41 (2026-11-06) applied the operator's decisions to the 25 findings of 2026-09-10: 21 are gone and 4 still fire because no decision covered them. The snapshot had not been re-measured since 2026-09-10 and did not contain the demo catalogue, the launch seed or the E2E fixtures; re-measuring it brought 90 findings on those rows into view. They were already true of production, and they are listed here rather than hidden. docs/S41-catalog.md.
$how_to_shrink_this: Fix the row in the admin, re-measure with `node scripts/catalogue-safety.mjs --sql` through MCP, then delete the entry. The test fails if an entry no longer fires, so the list cannot quietly keep names of things that were already fixed.
